Consider the function $f(x)$ whose graph is shown above.

$$
f(x)={\begin{aligned}x+\frac{1}{2},\, & 0<x<1, \\ 0,\, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

- $f(x)\ge 0$ for all $x$
- ${\int }_{0}^{1}f(x)\,\text{d}x=1$
- $f(x)$ is a valid probability density function

choices.value: None of the statements are true
